name: [RETRO SLASHER] Forsaken: Free For All
desc:
Also known as Untitled Forsaken Engine

This game is basically a Forsaken PVP Game, Allowing 25 Players to choose Sentinels and Killers to fight on a map.
This game also has a gamemode where PVP is disabled and the goal is to hangout and more.

This is a passion project made for fun. Play as survivors or killers with characters like:
Noob, Shedletsky, Guest1337, Chance, Two Time, Dusekkar, Jane Doe, Slasher, etc

All Skins and Emotes are mostly free to use!

There's also unique skins and emotes and mechanics exclusive to this game.

This is a Forsaken engine I made so it's PRONE to bugs, expect them.
